title: "Hands-On: Reset Lab"

# Hands-On: Reset Lab

Walk one commit through soft, mixed, and hard on `desk-api`. Lose the line on purpose, and take it back from the reflog.

## Setup

```bash
cd ~/desk/desk-api
git switch main
git status
START=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo "$START"
```

Status is clean, aside from ignored files such as `.env`. If `git switch main` refuses, restore or commit the work left from the previous page.

```bash
echo "lab line" >> README.md
git add README.md
git commit -m "lab: scratch line"
```

## Soft

```bash
git reset --soft HEAD~1
git status
git diff --staged -- README.md
```

The line is under “Changes to be committed”. `git log --oneline` does not show `lab: scratch line`.

```bash
git commit -m "lab: scratch line"
```

Same tree, new hash. The next mode starts from a commit again.

## Mixed

```bash
git reset HEAD~1
git status
git diff -- README.md
```

Git prints `Unstaged changes after reset:`. The line is in the file and not in the index.

```bash
git add README.md
git commit -m "lab: scratch line"
```

## Hard, and an untracked file

```bash
echo "not tracked" > notes.tmp
git reset --hard HEAD~1
git status
grep "lab line" README.md || echo "line gone"
ls notes.tmp
```

Tracked files match the commit in `$START`. `notes.tmp` is still in the directory. `--hard` left it there.

## Recover with the reflog

```bash
git reflog -5
```

The first line is this reset (`HEAD@{0}`). The next line (`HEAD@{1}`) is `commit: lab: scratch line`. `HEAD@{1}` means “where `HEAD` was one move ago.” That is a different question from `HEAD~1`, the parent of the current commit. Chapter 17 is that difference in full.

```bash
git reset --hard HEAD@{1}
grep "lab line" README.md
git log --oneline -1
```

The line is back. `main` names the scratch commit again.

## Leave the repo as you found it

```bash
git reset --hard "$START"
rm -f notes.tmp
git status
git log --oneline -5
```

`$START` is the tip from the start of the lab, so this last reset also drops `lab: scratch line`.

## Done when

- `git status` is clean (an ignored `.env` is fine)
- `notes.tmp` is gone
- the log has no `lab: scratch line`
- `README.md` has no `lab line`
- you saw that line staged, then unstaged, then missing, then restored from `HEAD@{1}`

Chapter 8 creates branches from this same `desk-api`. A reset of shared `main` waits; merging and rebasing come first.
